title: Hazmat Placarding: Table 1, Table 2 and the 1,001-Pound Rule
excerpt: How 49 CFR 172.504 decides when a vehicle must be placarded: which materials need placards in any quantity, how the 1,001-pound exception works, and four loads worked through.
meta_title: Hazmat Placarding Rules: Tables 1 and 2 Explained
meta_description: When a truck carrying hazardous materials must be placarded under 49 CFR 172.504: Table 1 versus Table 2 materials, the weight exception, the DANGEROUS placard and worked examples.
